shots.image: Close-up of HEROFACE, bare-chested with bare shoulders and no shirt, his head just above black water in a tiny air pocket under a rusty steel ceiling of a flooded ship cabin, the ceiling a hand's width above his head, water up to his chin, lit only by the cold white beam of a flashlight from above, everything else pitch dark, water drops on his face, wide frightened eyes.
shots.motion: He breathes heavily and looks up at the ceiling, the water ripples around his chin, the flashlight beam trembles.

shots.image: Deep underwater on a sandy sea floor thirty meters down, a capsized small ocean tugboat with no markings resting keel-up: its rounded orange hull bottom faces up toward the surface with the rudder and a large propeller sticking up on top, and its white wheelhouse is underneath, crushed into the sand. Dim blue-green light filtering down from far above, floating particles, a few fish, murky water.
shots.motion: The camera glides slowly toward the upside-down wreck, fish swim past, particles drift in the water.

shots.image: HEROFACE, bare-chested with bare shoulders, standing in a dark air pocket under a low steel ceiling, water up to his chest, a bright light glowing up from deep under the water and lighting his face from below, his eyes wide with sudden hope as he looks down at the glowing water.
shots.motion: Light ripples across his face from the water below, he stares down in disbelief, slow push-in.

shots.image: Night at sea off the coast of West Africa, rough dark waves, a small white-and-orange ocean tugboat with no markings working beside a huge oil tanker, an offshore oil platform with bright lights in the distance, spray, heavy clouds.
shots.motion: The tugboat rolls on the heavy swell, waves crash against its bow, the lights of the platform glitter, the camera slowly drifts.

shots.image: Inside the small cramped galley of a tugboat at night, HEROFACE wearing a plain white T-shirt and dark shorts, stirring a big pot of stew on the stove, pots hanging on hooks, warm yellow light, a round porthole showing the dark sea.
shots.motion: He stirs the pot and smiles, the galley rocks with the waves, the hanging pots swing.

shots.image: Night at sea in a storm, a huge dark wave lifts a small white-and-orange ocean tugboat with no markings and rolls it over onto its side, white spray exploding, the deck lights tilting, heavy rain.
shots.motion: The tugboat rolls over onto its side and capsizes as the wave breaks over it, spray explodes, the camera shakes.

shots.image: Underwater in deep dark blue water at night, a small white-and-orange ocean tugboat with no markings, seen from the side, completely submerged and drifting in open water, its deck lights still glowing, thousands of small round air bubbles all around it, no water surface and no sea floor visible, deep blue darkness all around.
shots.motion: The upside-down tugboat sinks slowly down into the darkness, bubbles stream upward, its lights flicker.

shots.image: Deep underwater, a capsized small white-and-orange ocean tugboat with no markings, keel-up with its orange hull bottom and propeller on top and its white wheelhouse underneath, slamming roof-first into the sandy sea floor, a huge cloud of sand billowing up around it, dim blue-green light, bubbles.
shots.motion: A huge cloud of sand billows up and outward around the upside-down wreck as it settles onto the sea floor, bubbles rise, fish scatter.

shots.image: Inside a cramped ship's toilet cubicle tilted on its side, white tiled walls, a small toilet and a sink, HERO bracing himself against the walls in terror as dark sea water bursts in through the door, a single flickering ceiling light.
shots.motion: Water floods in through the door, the room rolls over, the light flickers out, the camera shakes.

shots.image: Underwater inside a flooded upside-down ship corridor, almost completely dark, HERO pulling himself along the wall with his hands, holding his breath, cheeks puffed, bubbles escaping from his nose, a faint blue glow, floating debris.
shots.motion: He pulls himself along the corridor wall, bubbles rise, debris floats past, the camera follows.

shots.image: HERO bursting up out of black water into a small air pocket just under the low steel ceiling of a flooded ship cabin, only his head and shoulders out of the water, mouth wide open gasping for air, water splashing around him, dim blue light.
shots.motion: He gasps for air with his chest heaving, water splashes around him and ripples spread across the dark water.

shots.image: In a dark air pocket inside a flooded ship cabin, HERO holding up a small plain plastic bottle of dark soda, completely blank with no label, no logo and no text, in one hand and a small yellow flashlight in the other, the flashlight beam lighting his tired face, water up to his waist.
shots.motion: He switches on the flashlight and looks at the bottle, the beam swings across the dark water.

shots.image: Close-up of HEROFACE, bare-chested with bare shoulders and no shirt, in near darkness, holding a small yellow plastic flashlight next to his face, its bulb glowing a very faint dim orange, almost dead, no flame, fear in his eyes, black water around him.
shots.motion: The flashlight flickers and fades until only darkness is left, he stares at it in fear.

shots.image: Underwater beside the dark orange keel-up hull of a capsized small tugboat on the sandy sea floor, its propeller on top, a large school of silver fish and two barracudas swarming and darting around an open hatch in the hull, murky blue-green water, dim light.
shots.motion: The fish swarm and dart around the hull, the barracudas circle, particles drift.

shots.image: In a pitch-dark flooded ship cabin, HERO pressing his ear against the cold steel wall, listening in horror, his eyes wide, faint blue light, water up to his chest.
shots.motion: He presses his ear to the wall and flinches in horror, the water ripples, slow push-in.

shots.image: In a tiny dark air pocket inside an upside-down flooded ship cabin, HERO sitting hunched on two soggy mattresses piled on a ledge just above the black water, his hands clasped in prayer, eyes closed, exhausted, sweat on his skin, dim cold blue light.
shots.motion: He prays with his eyes closed, breathing heavily, his shoulders rise and fall, the water ripples below.

shots.image: Calm sea in the morning, a large diving support ship with a crane lowering a yellow diving bell into the water, diving equipment on the deck, clear blue sky.
shots.motion: The crane lowers the diving bell into the sea, water splashes, the camera slowly circles.

shots.image: Underwater inside a dark flooded upside-down ship corridor, a commercial diver in a black wetsuit and a yellow diving helmet with a bright helmet light and an air hose, swimming toward the camera, the beam of his light cutting through the murky water, floating particles.
shots.motion: The diver swims slowly through the corridor toward the camera, his light beam sweeps across the walls, bubbles rise from his helmet.

shots.image: Underwater in a dark flooded ship corridor, the bright beam of a diver's light falls on a man's bare dark-skinned hand reaching out of the black water ahead, fingers spread, floating particles.
shots.motion: The diver's gloved hand slowly reaches toward the hand in the light, particles drift.

shots.image: Extreme close-up underwater, a man's bare dark-skinned hand suddenly gripping the black-gloved hand of a diver tightly, lit by a bright diver's light, bubbles, dark water all around.
shots.motion: The bare hand grabs the gloved hand and grips it tightly, bubbles burst, the light shakes.

shots.image: In a small air pocket inside a dark flooded ship cabin, HERO face to face with a commercial diver in a yellow diving helmet with a bright light, the light shining on HERO's tearful relieved face, the diver's gloved hand on his shoulder, water up to their chests.
shots.motion: The diver grips his shoulder, he laughs and cries with relief, the light shimmers on the water.

shots.image: Inside a small white metal decompression chamber on a ship, HERO wrapped in a grey blanket sitting on a narrow bunk, seen through a round porthole window, exhausted but alive, soft warm light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in through the porthole as he breathes deeply and smiles weakly.

shots.image: On the deck of a diving support ship at sunset, HEROFACE wearing a black diving suit, holding a yellow diving helmet under his arm, standing tall and looking out at the calm golden sea.
shots.motion: Slow drone shot circling around him as he looks out at the sea, the sun glitters on the water.

shots.image: HEROFACE wearing a plain grey T-shirt and jeans, standing alone on an empty beach with his arms folded, staring at the grey ocean waves with fear in his eyes, overcast sky, wind.
shots.motion: The waves roll in toward him, the wind moves his T-shirt, he slowly steps back from the water, slow push-in.
